/.title: Organic Food Store & Millet Café in Jabalpur | Re Workshop
/.description: Shop organic grains, stone-milled flours and wood-pressed oils, or eat at our open-kitchen millet café on Ridge Road, Jabalpur. No maida in anything we cook.

/shop.title: Organic Grocery in Jabalpur: Millets, Atta, Dals & Oils | Re Workshop
/shop.description: Millets, stone-milled atta, unpolished dals, wood-pressed oils, desi ghee, jaggery and millet snacks at Re Workshop's organic store on Ridge Road, Jabalpur. Order on WhatsApp or visit us.

/cafe.title: Open-Kitchen Millet Café in Jabalpur | Re Workshop
/cafe.description: Millet dishes cooked in an open kitchen you can watch, on Ridge Road, Jabalpur: ragi bread sandwiches, creamy millet pasta, millet dhokla chaat and more. No maida, no refined oil.

/our-story.title: Our Story | Re Workshop, Organic Food Store in Jabalpur
/our-story.description: Why Re Workshop exists: Amrit Krishi soil, heritage seeds, stone-milled grains and an open-kitchen café in Jabalpur, and the three founders behind it.

/farmers.title: For Farmers: Farm With Us | Re Workshop, Jabalpur
/farmers.description: Farm with Re Workshop, Jabalpur: living soil, native seeds and Amrit Krishi. If you farm without chemicals, want to switch, or keep native seed varieties, tell us about your farm on WhatsApp.
